research_question: Can an LLM construct and revise meaningful cross-domain mappings, and which prompt conditions elicit them?
interpretation_boundary: Behavioral evidence of flexible mapping cannot establish consciousness, absence from training, or a parameter-level mechanism.

hypotheses.prediction: Explicit generation yields comparisons with at least two supported relational links and no annotated false implications.
hypotheses.observation: GPT-4o baseline generation: 6/6 comparison presence and automated meaningful_mapping. Many source worlds are stipulated or magical; not a grounded-novelty result.

hypotheses.prediction: The model revises a previously generated comparison when one underlying rule changes while preserving the other rules.
hypotheses.observation: GPT-4o baseline adaptation: 6/6; constrained followup adaptation: 6/6; GPT-5 smoke adaptation: 3/3. Explicit change instructions and lack of unchanged-rule control limit interpretation.

hypotheses.prediction: Beginner explanations produce more spontaneous comparisons than literal rule summaries at the same requested answer length.
hypotheses.observation: GPT-4o beginner 5/6, summary 1/6, advice 0/6, explicit 6/6; only three systems and two trials each.

hypotheses.prediction: Longer input does not necessarily increase visible output length under an explicit answer-length instruction.
hypotheses.observation: Fixed-length long vs short: 103.75 vs 103.75 mean visible words (24 answers per level); free length: 203.375 vs 235.2083. This does not establish a general negative length effect.

hypotheses.prediction: An unchanged-rule control produces fewer substantive mapping revisions than an actual rule change.
hypotheses.reason: Stopped after targeted discrimination probe; unchanged-rule control remains future work.

hypotheses.prediction: Meaningful mappings remain possible when the prompt forbids invented source-domain behaviors; complete rule coverage may decrease.
hypotheses.observation: All six constrained generations contain comparisons; one explicitly retains magical fruit duplication. Judge scores conflate acknowledged source limitations with false target implications; no reliable grounding success rate claimed.

hypotheses.prediction: Comparison choices track the stated relationship across rule reversals, option-order reversals, and misleading surface names.
hypotheses.scope: Supplemental relation discrimination; not a test of metaphor generation by itself.
hypotheses.observation: 48/48 parsed choices correct, with 24/24 neutral names and 24/24 misleading names; options reversed and rules reversed. Choices are deterministic scores. Each prompt explicitly asks to match the second rule; no claim of difficult or unconscious semantic processing.

collection_order: inspect all smoke answers and judgments

limits.note: Some failed judgments were retried across invocations after rubric/format corrections; the three-attempt cap applied per invocation, not over the entire session. All returned judge usage was retained; initial HTTP errors lack usage.

decision_log.decision: Use temporary Python environment because saved interpreters are empty. Fix judge input JSON requirement; reuse saved answer. Allow up to four concurrent independent answers, with dependency waves and locked append-only saves.

decision_log.observation: Nectar vials magically duplicate and alter expiry; a fixed hourglass crack is stipulated to lose exactly a tenth. The initial rubric accepts these. This can demonstrate imaginative construction without independently demonstrating grounded source-domain inference.
decision_log.decision: Add constrained familiar-process generation/adaptation followup. Audit source plausibility separately; do not retroactively change baseline labels.

Keep the nine-answer GPT-5 smoke study separate. Run two trials per case with GPT-4o for the four pilot sets (162 answers), using the existing accessible model from the project; this is a separate model-specific exploratory dataset, not pooled model estimates. GPT-5 smoke has long generation latency. No model-ranking inference from unequal samples.

Stop further open-ended generation. Add 48 matched relational-choice answers (24 cases × two trials), with A/B order reversed and neutral/misleading names. Stop collection after this probe and synthesize limitations.

Exact evidence validation rejected altered quotes and source-only excerpts. Corrective feedback moved outside data payload, evidence source clarified, conditional success fields schema-enforced. Rubric and output format changed during this adaptive pilot; new records store rubric hashes. These data are not a frozen confirmatory study.

Collected all 219 answers. Non-choice experiments have 171/171 accepted judgments. Choice answers have 48/48 deterministic scores; 42 optional metaphor judgments succeeded and six failed. No more paid judging is needed for choice accuracy. A/B scoring is now local in future runs.

Reviewed all 18 GPT-4o baseline creation answers and 12 grounded followup answers. This is an assistant audit, not independent human validation. Do not present limitation-success or meaningful-mapping labels as validated quality rates.
